ValidationRule.description:
This rule will restrict the states that are allowed to be sent to LoanMe.
**7/11/16 - Removed Iowa from restricted list** **3/25/16 - Added MN to the restricted List**
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Reason_Closed__c, 'Sent to LoanMe'), OR( Physical_Address_State__c = 'AK', Physical_Address_State__c = 'AR', Physical_Address_State__c = 'CO', Physical_Address_State__c = 'CT', Physical_Address_State__c = 'FL', Physical_Address_State__c = 'GA', Physical_Address_State__c = 'MA', Physical_Address_State__c = 'MI', Physical_Address_State__c = 'MT', Physical_Address_State__c = 'MN', Physical_Address_State__c = 'NV', Physical_Address_State__c = 'NY', Physical_Address_State__c = 'ND', Physical_Address_State__c = 'OK', Physical_Address_State__c = 'PA', Physical_Address_State__c = 'RI', Physical_Address_State__c = 'SD', Physical_Address_State__c = 'TN', Physical_Address_State__c = 'TX', Physical_Address_State__c = 'VT', Physical_Address_State__c = 'WV'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: LoanMe is restricted in the state that the customer is located in. Please Decline the transaction for a different reason and do not send the deal to LoanMe. Thank you.
